content: MK reports that Ibn Turka wrote a Sharḥ al-Nahj (Tarjuma-yi Aḥādīth az Ḥażrat-i Amīr), drawing on the Firdaws al-Akhbār of Shīrawayh Daylamī and the Musnad of Aḥmad b. Ḥanbal, and places it in the Sunni tradition of manāqib works on ʿAlī and the Imams.
refers_to_primary: Ibn Turka, Sharḥ al-Nahj / Tarjuma-yi Aḥādīth az Ḥażrat-i Amīr, MS Majlis 10196 f. 330a
